campaign-3-elmshorn.desc: Be the architect of a private collector's dream aquarium!
elmshorn_intro.title: Welcome to Elmshorn
elmshorn_intro.text.0:
A private collector wants to build a new public aquarium from scratch, and they want you to be the architect!

They've already installed a large tank to be the centerpiece of the aquarium.
elmshorn_intro.text.2: The rest is down to you. Get the aquarium ready to open!
elmshorn_intro.text.3: (Remember to fulfil your animals' Care Requirements to maximise their point value!)
elmshorn_corals_popup.title: Curious about Corals
elmshorn_corals_popup.text.0: The collector wants to explore the world of Corals with your help! Your next objective is to unlock the Disco Mushroom and add one to your aquarium.
elmshorn_corals_popup.text.2:
You should expand your aquarium to increase your Ecology <sprite name="ecology"> and Science <sprite name="science"> income. More tanks and more animals equals more income!

Also, keep an eye on your profits, even with the collector's investment, you'll need to manage the aquarium profitably!
elmshorn_disco_popup.title: Tank lights
elmshorn_disco_popup.text.0: Most Corals, including the Disco Mushroom, need light to supplement their food.
elmshorn_disco_popup.text.2: You'll need to add a Light to each tank that contains Corals. The cost of the Light is proportional to the <sprite name="volume"> of the tank, so smaller tanks are cheaper to light.
elmshorn_corals_stage2_popup.title: The list
elmshorn_corals_stage2_popup.text.0:
Congratulations on obtaining your first Coral!

The collector is currently compiling a wishlist of what they want for the aquarium.

In the meantime, you should continue to unlock new animals and equipment and try to progress to Rank 5.

As you expand your aquarium, it becomes easy for some tanks to get missed by your Guests. You can get feedback on this via the View Rate overlay, toggled using the button in the top-right of the screen.
adjacentPlatform.tooltip: Use the Platform Tool found in the top left to build platforms. It will automatically select the right height for the tank when you move adjacent, but the height can be fine-tuned with the mouse wheel.
stairsToFloor.tooltip: Use the stairs tool found in the top left to build stairs. Move the cursor next to a platform and drag away to build stairs all the way to the floor.
elmshorn_corals_stage3_popup.title: The list is revealed
elmshorn_corals_stage3_popup.text.0:
Great job! The collector is ready to reveal the list.

It centers around three Corals: Blue Tubular Sponge, Daisy Star Polyps and Toadstool Leather Coral.
elmshorn_corals_stage3_popup.text.4: To provide the higher light levels that these Corals demand, you'll need the Power Light.
elmshorn_corals_stage3_popup.text.6:
After this, you can obtain the Blue Tubular Sponge in the normal way, by unlocking it with Ecology <sprite name="ecology">.

The remaining Corals will need to be sourced from 3rd parties. I've arranged contact with two such parties who should be able to help. Check your message log when you're ready!
elmshorn_win_message.title: You win!
elmshorn_win_message.text.0:
Wow, you did it! You've managed to build a collector's dream aquarium, almost from scratch, mostly with the profits generated by the aquarium itself. You should be very proud!

With such a high profile client under your belt you've attracted the attention of the historic aquarium of Valberg.
elmshorn_win_message.text.2:
You can continue to build here at Elmshorn for as long as you want, this message will stay in your message log (accessible via the button in the bottom-left) until you're ready.

When you're ready to move to the chilly city of Valberg, let me know.
elmshorn_win_message.reply.0: I'm ready to take the job in Valberg.
trade_daisy_star_polyps.title: Need Daisy Star Polyps?
trade_daisy_star_polyps.text.0:
I heard you wanted some Daisy Star Polyps. I could supply you with some, but I need something from you first.

An important client needs a Porcupine Puffer but I'm having trouble locating one. If you can supply me with one, I'll sell you as many Daisy Star Polyps as you like!
trade_daisy_star_polyps.afterTrade: Thank you very much, look how cute he is! You'll find the Daisy Star Polyps in the Livestock section of the Build Menu.
opt_toadstool.title: Toadstool Leather Coral Donation?
opt_toadstool.text.0: I have a couple of Toadstool Leather Corals that I'd be willing to donate. Perhaps we could work on the design of the tank together?
opt_toadstool.reply.0: I suppose I could hear your suggestions...
opt_toadstool_complete.title: Toadstool Leather Coral delivery
opt_toadstool_complete.text.0: The display looks fantastic. As promised here are the Toadstool Leather Corals.
elmshorn_basic_skimmer.title: Protein Skimmer
elmshorn_basic_skimmer.text.0: You've just unlocked the Protein Skimmer.
elmshorn_basic_skimmer.text.2:
Filtering alone isn't enough to reach the high water qualities required by corals and delicate fish. You need Protein Skimming too.

Add one to your Disco Mushroom tank and see the difference in water quality compared to filtering alone.
elmshorn_deep_tanks.title: Deep Tanks
elmshorn_deep_tanks.text.2: Deep tanks require platforms at the back for your staff to access them for feeding. Build platforms with the Platform Tool found in the top left.
elmshorn_deep_tanks.text.4: Platforms require stairs to connect them to the ground. Build stairs with the Stairs Tool, also found in the top left.
elmshorn_oblique.title: Oblique-Lined Dottyback
elmshorn_oblique.text.0: You've just unlocked the Oblique-Lined Dottyback.
elmshorn_oblique.text.2:
The Oblique-Lined Dottyback has a Care Requirement you haven't seen before.

They Dislike Congeners which means they can't stand being around any other members of their 'Genus' or family.

For the Oblique-Lined Dottyback this means they cannot be kept with any Grammas, Anthias or Dottybacks including other Oblique-Lined Dottyback!
elmshorn_armored.title: Armored Animals
elmshorn_armored.text.0: You've just unlocked your first armored animal.
elmshorn_armored.text.2: Armored animals count as twice the size when determining whether they can be eaten by a predator. This makes them excellent tankmates for your fish and crustacean eating animals.
elmshorn_active_swimmer.title: Schooling Bannerfish
elmshorn_active_swimmer.text.0: You've just unlocked the Schooling Bannerfish.
elmshorn_active_swimmer.text.2: The Schooling Bannerfish is an Active Swimmer. This means their tank needs to have a minimum <sprite name="volume"> for them to have enough room to swim.
elmshorn_blue_knuckle.title: Blue Knuckle Hermit Crab
elmshorn_blue_knuckle.text.0: You've just unlocked the Blue Knuckle Hermit Crab.
elmshorn_blue_knuckle.text.2: The Blue Knuckle Hermit Crab is a Crustacean. Many fish eat Crustaceans so you have to be very careful who you put them with!
elmshorn_daisy_star: Check your message log and look for the message about Daisy Star Polyps.
elmshorn_toadstool: Check your message log and look for the message about Toadstool Leather Corals.
staffManagementA.title: Staff priorities
staffManagementA.text.0: Did you know you can give your staff different priorities for each task type?
staffManagementA.text.2:
Simply click the toggle next to the skill to increase or decrease the priority. Tasks which match the skill with the highest priority will always be completed before those with a lower priority.

By setting different priorities for different staff you can make sure you have the right people on the right jobs, and everything gets done.
elmshorn_toilets.title: Toilets
elmshorn_toilets.text.0: One of your Guests needs the toilet!
elmshorn_toilets.text.2: Build some Toilets so they have somewhere to relieve themselves.
buildToilet.tooltip: Find the Basic Toilet in the Facilities section of the Build Menu.
elmshorn_2_toadstool.tooltip: In this level you can't unlock Toadstool Leather Corals in the normal way. Check your message log, via the button in the bottom left of the screen, and look for an alternate way to acquire these rare corals!
elmshorn_4_daisy.tooltip: In this level you can't unlock Daisy Star Polyps in the normal way. Check your message log, via the button in the bottom left of the screen, and look for an alternate way to acquire these rare corals!
